description.narrative: THE PROGRAM INCLUDES: (I) TRANSMISSION: IMPROVEMENT OF 9 STATIONS OF THE "SISTEMA CENTRO-NORTE", CONSTRUCTION OF THE "CENTRO-SUR" TRANSMISSION SYSTEM, AND TRANSMISSION CONTROL SYSTEM IN THE SICN; AND (II) TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE FOR INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING OF THE TWO NEW TRANSMISSION COMPANIES, PRIVATIZATIONS STUDIES OF THE REGIONAL COMPANIES, AND STUDY TO REDUCE ENERGY LOSSES IN THE COASTAL SYSTEM AND SUPPORT THE MEM PLANNING FUNCTION.
